summary: Zapping a wand of wishing reaches zap.c:zapnodir WAN_WISHING, but JavaScript refuses before the rn2(5) Luck gate and makewish prompt. The C case wishes an ordinary food object after zapping; it does not exercise the older Grimtooth artifact-touch behavior. Port the whole zapnodir family and preserve the shared discovery tail and makewish input timing.

source.branch: zap.c:zapnodir WAN_WISHING draws rn2(5), compares it with Luck, either prints the unlucky failure or calls makewish(), then follows the common discovery tail.

dependencies: zap.c:makewish has a JavaScript production path, but a separate upward-boulder C probe reaches zap.c:makewish and diverges at the wish-finalization newline: C consumes rn2(100) where JS has no corresponding draw or screen. The v11 WAN_WISHING path may expose that later source defect after zapnodir is implemented.
The C case has a later 14-screen tail; once the initial refusal is removed, re-evaluate the entire session for additional source defects.
